suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require emphysema and subsequent lung/respiratory cancer; explicitly account for smoking and other carcinogenic exposures. Association is population-level and heavily confounded by shared tobacco/exposure risks; no individual causation claim. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Emphysema and Lung Cancer / Tracheal Cancer / Bronchial Cancer
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
